addresses.description:
An array of token addresses you want pricing data for. The `0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000` address represents the native coin on the given chain, `ETH` on Ethereum Mainnet or `MATIC` on Polygon Mainnet.

You can use the `address` from the [GET Tokens endpoint](https://docs.blockdaemon.com/reference/gettokens-pricing) to get the price for a particular token.

units.description: An array of quotes for the currency. For example, `USD` or `EUR`.
